The '''Standard X space suit''' was a model of [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] made by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and sold for 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. They were available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Standard X space suit was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. It was then mentioned again in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]], released by Fantasy Flight in the [[2014|following]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
